consensus_expectations: Capital IQ's frozen FQ3 2026 consensus is US$5,936.74m revenue (+42.3% year over year) and US$0.22164 GAAP EPS (+39.0%). The target-price mean is US$18.78, median US$19.00 and range US$10.00-US$23.00. FY2026 last-month revision breadth is 8 up/0 down for EPS and 5 up/2 down for revenue. The governance snapshot lists 33 contributors, but the exact contributor count behind each FQ3 line is not proven.
market_implied_expectations: At US$14.30, a residual-income model using the disclosed 16.51% Brazil Investments CGU rate requires about 47.36% terminal ROE or 80.89% FY2027-30 profit CAGR. The same modeled earnings path reconciles to the price at a 9.78% group-implied cost of equity. The price therefore requires either exceptional returns/growth duration or a materially lower group hurdle rate than the disclosed CGU rate.
engine_view: The engine's 12-month bull/base/bear fair values are US$8.43/US$6.47/US$4.40. The US$6.47 base equally blends US$7.38 peer NTM-P/E and US$5.55 residual income; the full valuation field spans US$2.95-US$7.92. The scenario distribution adds a 10% US$18.78 consensus-reconciliation tail and still produces a US$7.472 weighted target and -47.7483% expected return.
what_everyone_knows: Nu is a fast-growing Latin American digital bank: Q2 2026 had 139 million customers, 83.5% activity, 50.3% revenue growth and 66.3% diluted-EPS growth. Sell-side estimates and targets remain constructive.
what_is_priced_in: US$14.30 prices continued high growth and returns, or a group cost of equity near the 9.78% model-implied reconciliation rate. The US$18.78 mean target and upward FY2026 EPS revisions show that strong execution is not a hidden expectation.
what_market_may_be_missing: Current spread and revenue gains may precede the full credit-loss outcome, and the US$991.046m H1 deferred-tax benefit makes headline net income less cash-backed. These facts may make the earnings run-rate less durable than the price assumes, but they do not prove improper accounting or a future miss.
evidence_engine_is_different: There is no proven variant perception yet. The engine would be demonstrably different only if a sourced group-wide cost of equity is materially above 9.78% and the Q3 filing misses the raised revenue/EPS bar or shows worse credit quality. That evidence does not exist at the decision date; current consensus revisions and the Q2 dual beat point the other way.
base_rate_check: The run contains no adequate empirical reference class for Nu-like digital lenders sustaining high growth and 30%+ returns across a full credit cycle. The engine appropriately treats scenario and forecast probabilities as judgment. Its mature-bank peer anchors may be conservative for Nu, while extrapolating one strong quarter would also violate the base-rate rule; neither side has exceptional proof.
notes: The numerical gap is large: the US$6.47 base is 54.755245% below US$14.30. It is not robust enough to call an exploitable short because the valuation methods span 168%, the 16.51% rate is not group-wide, 9.78% can reconcile price, consensus points upward and no borrow/options evidence was supplied. The independent edge score is therefore below the decision record's 45 despite the large signed gap.
